reason: A local, read-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates session logs and presents token usage statistics through totals, heatmaps, streaks, and per-model breakdowns.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页中汇总本机会话日志并展示令牌用量、时间热力图、连续记录和模型明细。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates local session logs and displays token usage totals, activity heatmaps, streaks, and per-model details.

capabilities: Reads local DeepSeek Harness session logs from configured directories
Aggregates token usage statistics by time period and model
Displays statistics in a Settings page and serves a loopback JSON view model
Includes working-directory paths in the local payload
